note: Nebraska Game and Parks SRA on the Platte just south of Kearney, among small sandpit lakes, at the south end of the Fort Kearny hike-bike trail bridge. Two campgrounds (East and West): 44 sites reservable (Electric 30 A, Electric Plus 50 A, Basic) on gravel back-in driveways mostly 36-54 ft, the rest first come. No water or sewer at the sites; water is at the dump station. Open all year, but water, dump and modern restrooms may be off March 1 - April 10 (reduced rate). Showers. Busy in sandhill crane season. State park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: RA: 44 reservable sites (28 E 30 A, 10 EP 50 A, 6 Basic), gravel, open year round; quotes E $25 / EP $30 match the stored grid fees. Hookups corrected: water and sewer removed (every site 'Full Hookup - no'). Pin is 1.26 km off in woods east of the trail; move to the reservable loop. Waterfront lead down to not waterfront (lakes are 2.5-3.8 acre ponds).
flags: HOOKUPS changed: water true and sewer true removed (now unknown/none). Both came from 2026-09 note prose ('some water+sewer'). ReserveAmerica marks all 44 reservable sites 'Full Hookup - no', the Electric Plus site page lists only 'Electricity Hookup: 50', the park text puts water 'at the dump station', and the rates grid has no Full row for Fort Kearny. The first-come sites are not on ReserveAmerica, so this is not proof for them; nothing I read says they have water or sewer.

PIN MOVE (1,258 m): stored 40.6585,-98.9839 is in woods east of the hike-bike trail; no pads, tables or loops show there in imagery. ReserveAmerica's 38 located sites centre on 40.6531,-98.9970, between the pit ponds and the field at the south edge of the SRA. Suggest 40.6531,-98.9970. Google's 'Fort Kearny SRA Campground' point is 40.6546,-98.9894 (on the park road, ~640 m E of that centre).

WATERFRONT LEAD (down, lakeview -> not waterfront): the water next to the camping is a chain of small sandpit ponds. NIR flood fills: the pond north-west of sites 056-063 is 2.55 acres; the one north of 084-087 is 2.63 acres; the one north of the loops is 2.51 acres; the pond by Google's campground point is 3.82 acres. Third-party listings give 'seven pit lakes that total 21 acres'. Sites are 9-98 m from the nearest pond (closest: 062 at 9 m, 058 at 11 m, 057 at 19 m, 056 at 24 m, 084/085 at ~30 m). Every pond near the camping is under ~5 acres, so the pond rule allows no lake value. CONTRARY CLAIM: ReserveAmerica tags 16 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (V1, 056, 057, 058, 062, 063, 078, 080, 082, 084, 085, 086, 087, 088, 090, 093). The Platte channel is ~600+ m north behind woodland, with no view.

EAST vs WEST (not a split): all 44 reservable sites sit in one ReserveAmerica loop, which GIS places in the West area. The East Campground (Electric Plus only, per third-party listings) is probably near Google's 'Fort Kearny SRA Campground' point (~0.6-0.8 km east), off the same park road; its location is unconfirmed because the 2022 East Campground map is on the blocked outdoornebraska.gov. Under ~1 km, probably one entrance: no split proposed. Site counts beyond the 44 reservable (note's old '~94 electric, ~26 basic'; listings say 120 total) are unverified, so sites.count is not written.
FEES unchanged: the grid row (Basic $15 / Electric $25 / Electric Plus $30, $5 less off-season) matches ReserveAmerica's quotes for 6/15/2027 (E $25, EP $30). The fee group stays as stored.
SAND RULE: ReserveAmerica 'Driveway Surface: Gravel' on the Electric and Electric Plus sites; no beach camping. Passes.
FIT: one site is '24 Back-In' (058), one is '30' (V1); the rest are 32-54 ft. EKKO fits most sites.
